en.headline: Police arrest three teens over alleged assault at Lingnan Secondary School
en.dek: Eastern District officers detained three boys aged 13 to 15 on suspicion of common assault after a reported incident involving a 13-year-old student with disabilities.
body: Police arrested three teenagers on Friday in connection with an alleged assault on a 13-year-old boy at Lingnan Secondary School in Heng Fa Chuen.

The Eastern District anti-triad unit said the arrests took place in Eastern District and Sham Shui Po. The three boys, aged between 13 and 15, were suspected of common assault and were released on bail, required to report to police in mid-December.

The incident is understood to have occurred on the afternoon of 10 November on the school’s ground-floor basketball court while the boy, who has hearing impairment, autism, ADHD and learning difficulties, was having lunch. Reports indicated he was surrounded, punched, kicked and had a basketball thrown at him.

The school confirmed there had been a conflict between students, said it took the matter seriously, had activated its crisis management mechanism and was cooperating fully with police. It restated a zero-tolerance policy on campus bullying. Education Bureau officials have also been in contact with the school.

zh.headline: 警方拘捕三名少年 涉嶺南中學普通襲擊
zh.dek: 東區警區反黑組周五拘捕三名13至15歲少年，涉嫌在杏花邨嶺南中學對一名有多重障礙的13歲男生作出普通襲擊。
body: 警方周五在東區及深水埗區拘捕三名年齡介乎13至15歲的少年，涉嫌普通襲擊一名在杏花邨嶺南中學就讀的13歲男生。
東區警區反三合會行動組表示，三人已獲准保釋候查，須於12月中旬向警方報到。
據了解，事件發生於11月10日下午，事主在學校地下籃球場用膳期間被多名同學包圍、拳打腳踢，並有人將籃球扔向其背部。事主患有聽覺障礙、自閉症、過度活躍症及學習障礙。
校方確認學生之間有衝突，已高度重視並啟動危機處理機制，全力配合警方調查，重申對校園欺凌零容忍。教育局亦已聯絡學校跟進。
